memory_update.text: PDFS is the highest-purity US-listed candidate for semiconductor manufacturing data/orchestration; keep in underfollowed lane and prioritize verification of recurring software revenue, customer adoption, and advanced-packaging/AI-chip relevance.
ONTO is an adjacent process-control/yield-software candidate; relevance depends on whether software and factory analytics are material versus bundled with metrology/inspection hardware.

CAMT is a speculative shadow candidate for the data/orchestration node: strongest evidence is advanced-packaging inspection/metrology exposure plus Visual Layer AI analytics acquisition, but recurring software/data monetization remains unproven.
SNPS should be retained as a reference/comparison anchor, not an underfollowed discovery name, because it already has high market attention and broad EDA exposure.

Need a follow-up search specifically for US-listed test-data, equipment-connectivity, MES, STDF analytics, and OSAT/foundry data-sharing vendors; this pass found few pure-play public companies beyond PDFS.

node: Semiconductor manufacturing data, yield analytics, traceability, and orchestration software
summary: Expanded the universe around semiconductor manufacturing data/orchestration with a two-lane funnel. Reference lane: Synopsys as a high-attention EDA/manufacturing-analytics anchor. Underfollowed lane: PDF Solutions as the most direct pure-play data/orchestration candidate; Onto Innovation as a larger process-control/yield-software adjacent; Camtek as a speculative advanced-packaging inspection/data adjacency where visual AI and metrology data may become more valuable as AI packaging complexity rises. This pass deliberately avoids mega-cap chip designers and hyperscalers except as implicit demand anchors.
